argument_units.research_question: ConTEB benchmark: Evaluation suite that tests rerankers on challenging tasks requiring cross‑passage inference
argument_units.design_objective: ConTEB benchmark: Evaluation suite that tests rerankers on challenging tasks requiring cross‑passage inference, document‑wide context, and structural reasoning.

argument_units.design_objective: Architecture details: enriching embeddings with document ID and position, the Transformer encoder with hybrid attention (shared full + dedicated masked).

argument_units.research_question: Hybrid‑attention encoding: Feed the query and augmented passage embeddings into a Transformer encoder that applies shared full attention (global interactions) and dedicated masked attention (intra‑document interactions) in every layer, producing contextualized passage embeddings.
argument_units.design_objective: Hybrid‑attention encoding: Feed the query and augmented passage embeddings into a Transformer encoder that applies shared full attention (global interactions) and dedicated masked attention (intra‑document interactions) in every layer, producing contextualized passage embeddings.

argument_units.research_question: shared full attention module: Standard multi‑head attention allowing query and all passages to attend to each other;
argument_units.design_objective: shared full attention module: Standard multi‑head attention allowing query and all passages to attend to each other; captures global relevance and cross‑document relationships.

argument_units.research_question: Transformer encoder stack: Layers that process the combined sequence to produce contextualized passage embeddings.
argument_units.design_objective: Transformer encoder stack: Layers that process the combined sequence to produce contextualized passage embeddings.

argument_units.research_question: Train on ConTEB datasets that explicitly require cross‑passage reasoning.
argument_units.design_objective: Train on ConTEB datasets that explicitly require cross‑passage reasoning.

argument_units.research_question: Retrieval and embedding preparation: Use a dense retriever (Contriever) to fetch top‑k candidate passages and their pre‑computed embeddings; encode the query with the same model.
argument_units.design_objective: Retrieval and embedding preparation: Use a dense retriever (Contriever) to fetch top‑k candidate passages and their pre‑computed embeddings; encode the query with the same model.

argument_units.research_question: Contriever: Dense retriever that provides initial passage embeddings and top‑k retrieval.
argument_units.design_objective: Contriever: Dense retriever that provides initial passage embeddings and top‑k retrieval.

argument_units.research_question: Structural augmentation: For each retrieved passage, add a dynamic document ID embedding and a sinusoidal passage‑position encoding to its original embedding to inject document‑identity and ordering signals.
argument_units.design_objective: Structural augmentation: For each retrieved passage, add a dynamic document ID embedding and a sinusoidal passage‑position encoding to its original embedding to inject document‑identity and ordering signals.

argument_units.research_question: passage position encoding (sinusoidal): Encodes the position of a passage within its original document, providing
argument_units.design_objective: passage position encoding (sinusoidal): Encodes the position of a passage within its original document, providing structural order cues.

argument_units.research_question: Inject document‑level structural knowledge into passage embeddings to support cross‑passage inference.
argument_units.design_objective: Inject document‑level structural knowledge into passage embeddings to support cross‑passage inference.

argument_units.research_question: Use relative, dynamic document ID assignments rather than global corpus‑level IDs.
argument_units.design_objective: Use relative, dynamic document ID assignments rather than global corpus‑level IDs.

argument_units.research_question: document ID embedding table: Learned relative document‑identity embeddings assigned dynamically to unique documents in
argument_units.design_objective: document ID embedding table: Learned relative document‑identity embeddings assigned dynamically to unique documents in the candidate set, enabling the model to recognize which passages belong together.

argument_units.research_question: hybrid attention mechanism: Combines shared full attention (global cross‑passage) and dedicated masked attention
argument_units.design_objective: hybrid attention mechanism: Combines shared full attention (global cross‑passage) and dedicated masked attention (intra‑document) in each Transformer layer to jointly model inter‑ and intra‑document dependencies.

argument_units.research_question: dedicated masked attention module: Masked multi‑head attention that restricts a passage to attend only to the query and
argument_units.design_objective: dedicated masked attention module: Masked multi‑head attention that restricts a passage to attend only to the query and to other passages from the same document, enabling fine‑grained coreference resolution and local coherence.

argument_units.research_question: Design two complementary attention patterns that co‑exist in each layer: global and document‑local.
argument_units.design_objective: Design two complementary attention patterns that co‑exist in each layer: global and document‑local.

argument_units.design_objective: Training objective: InfoNCE loss with fixed query anchor.

argument_units.design_objective: Contrastive training: Using a contrastive InfoNCE loss, pull the updated positive passage embedding toward the fixed query embedding and push negative passage embeddings away.

argument_units.research_question: Keep the query embedding fixed during training and inference while updating passage embeddings.
argument_units.design_objective: Keep the query embedding fixed during training and inference while updating passage embeddings.

argument_units.design_objective: InfoNCE contrastive loss: Objective that encourages the updated positive passage embedding to align with the fixed query embedding while separating negatives.

argument_units.design_objective: fixed query anchor: The original query embedding remains unchanged during training/inference to serve as a stable reference in the contrastive objective.

argument_units.design_objective: MLDR, SQuAD, NarrativeQA (training sets): Three ConTEB datasets used for training EBCAR, covering entity disambiguation, span matching, and narrative comprehension.

argument_units.research_question: Inference scoring and ranking: Compute dot‑product similarities between the unchanged query embedding and the contextualized passage embeddings, then sort passages by descending score.
argument_units.design_objective: Inference scoring and ranking: Compute dot‑product similarities between the unchanged query embedding and the contextualized passage embeddings, then sort passages by descending score.

argument_units.design_objective: Improve reranking in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems by addressing both inference efficiency and the need for cross-passage reasoning, especially when evidence is scattered across passages and requires resolving coreference or structural context.
